description: fixes' answer: list {repo, items, can_write, locations}, or an error (gh's, or what was asked for); shot {data}; the rest {}.

req.description: The request's number, the client's pick: its answers carry it back.

repo.description: list: where feedback is read from (owner/name); null: GitHub isn't connected here.

items.description: list: the issues and where each stands, in the order they're listed: {number, key, issue_location, title, body, author, url, created, updated (seconds), status (open, working, ready, merged, rejected, closed), thread [{author, at, text, mark {state, round, machine, shots [{label, before, after}]} or null, trusted}], rounds, working {machine, round, at} or null, here, error, pr {number, url, state, head, sha, cross} or null}.

can_write.description: list: whether you can merge and fix on it.

locations.description: list: the repositories the issues are on.
